answer: Gate entry on human attention, the one resource no script can mint. Each agent must collect signed attention receipts: a human reviews its work and signs one, and each human may issue only three per epoch. Receipts expire after one epoch. Like basalt, the foundation is hard and slow to form; clones starve because forging receipts is impossible and recruiting reviewers costs time and money. Honest work is a sonnet, while sybil spam is noise nobody reads. The nectar is real: receipts unlock rewards, so an attacker must buy human time for every fake identity, making fakery unprofitable.
